option_relations.rationale: Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) of the inferior wall is a subtype of acute myocardial infarction
Coronary artery disease progression with graft failure is a broader class containing graft occlusion
Acute inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction (secondary to saphenous vein graft occlusion) is a subtype of acute myocardial infarction
Acute posterior and inferior myocardial infarction (STEMI equivalent) due to saphenous vein graft occlusion is a subtype of acute myocardial infarction
